source: Ported from llmfit 1.1.18 (MIT, Alex Jones): llmfit-core/src/models.rs quant_bpp, quant_bytes_per_param, quant_speed_multiplier, quant_quality_penalty. See LICENSE.

fields.bpp: bytes per parameter for MEMORY (weights on disk/in VRAM, incl. format overhead)
fields.speedBpp: bytes per parameter read per token for the SPEED estimate
fields.speedMultiplier: speed factor for the fallback (unknown-GPU / CPU) estimate
fields.qualityPenalty: points taken off a model's quality estimate at this quant (0 = no loss)
